detail: Validation-only calibration succeeded and did not increase NLL.
Four-model common set contains 24,760 claims per model.
No ERROR/FATAL entries found in the source audit.
User bootstrap rows used 10,000 replicates; session-block rows used 2,000 replicates.
All session-block bootstrap rows preserved both classes: True.
Metric CIs excluding their original point estimate: 0 of 84.
Paired-delta CIs excluding their original point estimate: 0 of 60.
The test split contains one genuine source session per claimed user; within-user genuine-session variability cannot be estimated.
Claim-level McNemar is retained only as a descriptive sensitivity analysis because claims share windows and sessions.
Random Forest and Linear SVM are unavailable under all-impostor evaluation because Stage 3 did not save reusable fitted model objects.
